ask: Evan, 2026-10-23 13:50Z: "spin a new study on 2D character rigging and animation? maybe we have enough understanding of humans to start drawing these things professionally in pieces with SVG tracing over top of 2D inspired SVGs built from midjourney turnarounds etc."
character: Blue-graphite wooden mannequin (shared with AW-STUDY-0038). Fictional adults only; the kids are never traced from photos.

scoring.creative: ARTIST_METHOD.md section 2, 12 checks, 0-2 each, by eye; under 16 of 24 is a study, not a pick
scoring.joint_cover: share of each joint disc (0.8 of its radius) that is covered in a stress pose; tools/rig2d/score.mjs
scoring.seam_ink: share of pixels inside the body silhouette near each joint that are outline ink; lower is better
scoring.animation: six of the 12 principles (Thomas and Johnston; Cooper, Game Anim), 0-2 each, by eye on the filmstrips

reps.title: Rectangles cut at the joints
reps.practising: Where one piece ends and the next begins
reps.lesson: Pieces cut square at the joint open a wedge on the outside of every bend and poke corners out on the inside.
reps.next: Make each end a disc centred on its pivot.

reps.title: Discs on the pivots
reps.practising: Joints that hold at any angle
reps.lesson: A disc of the same radius on both pieces, centred on the pivot, closes every gap at every angle. But tubes of even width are sausages, not a body.
reps.next: Draw the forms: offset bulges, straight against curve.

reps.title: Drawn forms: straight against curve
reps.lesson: Profiles from the body study (deltoid high outside, biceps low inside, calf high outside and low inside) read as a body and still close every joint. But each piece draws its own outline, so a seam line crosses every joint.
reps.next: Draw one outline per body, under all its fills.

reps.title: One outline per body (the auto-patch)
reps.lesson: Drawing every outline of a body first and every fill on top (Toon Boom's auto-patch) removes the seams, and the body reads as one silhouette. Arms are their own group, so they keep a line where they cross the chest.
reps.next: Turn it sideways and make it move.

reps.title: Side view, IK legs, first jump
reps.lesson: Two-bone IK plants the feet, so a walk is easy to key. But the first jump is evenly timed, has no wind-up and flattens the body to 70% of its area on landing: it reads as cardboard bouncing.
reps.next: Key it pose to pose: wind-up, stretch, tuck, reach, squash that keeps its area, arms that arrive late.

reps.title: Anticipation, area-true squash, arcs, overlap
reps.lesson: Same rig, same pieces: a crouch before the jump, a stretch at take-off, a tuck at the top, a reach for the ground, a squash that keeps its area (width times height stays 1), and arms trailing by a tenth of a second then overshooting. Now it has weight.
reps.next: Trace the Midjourney ranch hand onto this rig, one view per skin.
